headline_seed: Patrick Stewart, legendary actor of ‘Star Trek’ and ‘X-Men’ fame, dies at 86 - AP News
draft_text:
Patrick Stewart, 86, died Wednesday at his Los Angeles home after what spokesperson Kelly Bush Novak called "a brief and poignant journey" with Alzheimer's and Lewy body dementia, per AP and CBS News. He is survived by his wife Sunny and two children.

And that's the mews.
